referenceFunction.generalComment: In 2019 58% of the imported Algerian natural gas to RER was imported by pipeline and 42% as LNG. geography.text: The data for storage emissions are based on global data. The amount of gas stored is a rough estimate based on European data. The average weighted transport distance is based on the trade movements 2019.
